profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
⚠️ I am currently NOT open for new job offers.
⚠️ My visa is only valid for my current employer.
⚠️ I am not a d0tN3t developer anymore!

Sorry, I'm not answering messages anymore. I've being receiving too many massages, it has become my second job to answer recruiters... 😅

# OCPJP (Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 6 Programmer)
# AWS Certified Developer Associate
# XGH Certified Professional

# Programming languages (most used recently):
- Java
- Javascript
- Python 3
- Go Lang
- Groovy 💚
- Bash
- Some experience with Kotlin, Ruby and a certain Microsoft language, similar to Java, but not fluent

# Back-end technologies:
- Spring Boot
- Java EE (EJB, CDI, JPA, JAX-RS)
- Spock framework 🖖🏻 / GEB / JUnit / unittests
- Kafka, Kinesis, NATS, JMS
- FFMPEG and video processing in general

# Front-end technologies:
- React
- AngularJS
- Angular (not so much 🙁)
- Svelte (still learning...)

# Database technologies:
- MS SQL Server
- Elasticsearch
- DynamoDB
- Couchbase
- Redis
- H2 / SQLite
- Teradata (SQL Teradata, TPT, Mload, Fload, Fexp, etc)

# DevOps:
- AWS (EC2, S3, ECS, Lambda, Network, Kinesis, SQS, SNS, etc)
- Docker / Docker compose
- CDK / Cloudformation
- Terraform / Packer

# Tooling (JetBrains IDEs, Maven, Gradle, Yarn / Webpack, Git)
# Some experience with other technologies like Android

# Personal style:
- Engaged!
- Adventurer: Need to try new languages!
- Conservative: Still using Java
- Lazy efficiency: Better write a script for that
- Powered by Coffee and Metal 🤘

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
We create solutions to our client.
Some bigger projects include the migration of legacy systems from on-premise infrastructure to AWS, including the architectural design, PoCs, reimplementation, deployment and guaranteeing security requirements.
I am also a developer and maintainer of a video streaming and clipping solution with millions of users on US.

positions.locationName: Rio de Janeiro e Região, Brasil

positions.title: Software developer - IT Consultant
positions.description:
As an experienced software developer, I help the team to code better.
My role in the team is to provide better solutions and share them with my teammates.
I'm recognized by my Java and Javascript skills, but I'm usually dealing with all sorts of technologies.

My team is responsible for providing solutions to help the client's business to improve in quality, speed and optimizing resources, rethinking processes to save time and money.
I act as the focal point for technical expertise, always trying to reduce complexity and making things work, helping to keep the focus on the value for the business.

positions.title: Analista Senior
positions.description:
Desenvolvedor de software na área de Business Process Management na área de Ciclo da Receita da Oi.
Sou da equipe de Novas Soluções, desenvolvo portais gerenciais em Java, os mais variados sistemas, processos de carga em banco de dados Teradata, administração de servidores, performatização de queries e sistemas.

positions.title: Analista Junior
positions.description:
- Desenvolvimento de soluções em Java
- Desenvolvimento SQL
- Administração de servidores Windows

positions.title: Eletricista
positions.description:
Programa de Formação de Mão de Obra da antiga MBR (a Vale realizou uma fusão com a MBR na metade do programa)
Ao término do programa fui para uma terceirizada, a Ance Engenharia como eletricista I e depois fui para a CCS como eletricista IV onde fiquei somente pelo período de experiência.
Manutenção corretiva e preventiva nos equipamentos de embraque e desembarque de minério de ferro. Baixa e alta tensão.
Responsável pela manutenção do pier (com shiploader)
Alguns equipamentos: Contatoras de potência, inversores de frequência (Telemecanique/Siemens), motores CA diversos, sensores de alinhamento de correia, sensores capacitivos e indutivos, coletor de materiais metálicos "Big Moe", PLC (ou CLP), cabos e instalações elétricas em geral.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Instrutor de Photoshop e suporte técnico no instituto.
Aulas gratuitas para moradores do município de Mangaratiba.
